actionable_findings.title: Outer DMG is never Developer ID signed before the required primary-signature assessment
actionable_findings.evidence: build-app.sh signs APP_BUNDLE at lines179-180, creates DMG at231-237, then verifies it at241-244. There is no codesign operation on DMG_PATH and dmg-settings.py provides no signing identity. The required DMG assessment fails with no usable signature after Apple Accepted and stapler validate success.
actionable_findings.root_cause_confidence: High from source plus exact failure signature. Failed CI artifact is unavailable for independent byte inspection.
actionable_findings.smallest_remedy: On the Developer ID path, sign the newly created outer DMG with the selected Developer ID Application identity and secure timestamp before notarization submission. Verify that outer signature and expected certificate before upload. Keep the existing Gatekeeper assessment.
actionable_findings.external_propagation_assessment: Current evidence indicates a deterministic missing container signature, not an Apple propagation delay. No blind retry is justified.
